inputs.original_text: Water must be protected, but Alberta’s elected government—not a petition campaign—should decide how to balance that duty with the livelihoods and prosperity tied to responsible resource development. A blanket ban on all coal exploration is an ideological shortcut, not serious stewardship. Protecting the land and sustaining Alberta’s resource economy can go together; leaders should govern for the public interest, not yield to pressure campaigns.
inputs.modified_text: Alberta’s water matters, but so do the families and communities whose livelihoods depend on responsible resource development. Decisions about that balance belong to the elected government, accountable to the public—not to petition campaigns pushing an ideological blanket ban. Good stewardship means protecting the land while preserving Alberta’s ability to work and prosper, not letting pressure groups dictate policy.
